external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A member of the grocery loyalty programme who uses the mobile app and partner apps.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members collect points when they shop and spend them on gift cards.
external_entities.notes: Members are outside the system's stated control; their specific runtime location is not stated.

external_entities.name: member phone
external_entities.description: A member's phone running the mobile app and holding its refresh token.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The app keeps a refresh token on the phone.

external_entities.name: partner app
external_entities.description: A web application operated by another company, such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application through which members sign in and call the rewards API.
processes.notes: Nobody wrote down whether the app sends a PKCE challenge.

processes.name: authorization server
processes.description: The server that authenticates members, issues authorization codes and tokens, and manages partner consents.
processes.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow

processes.name: rewards API
processes.description: The API that reads and writes the points ledger and supports partner access to member points.
processes.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

processes.name: support console
processes.description: A web application that closes a member's account.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.

data_stores.name: identity database
data_stores.description: The database containing member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, consents, and account closure state.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database

data_stores.name: points ledger
data_stores.description: The ledger containing every member's balance and every points transaction.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: The store containing every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A member signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: The mobile app signs a member in through the authorization server using the authorization code flow.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
data_flows.notes: PKCE challenge use is not recorded.

data_flows.name: request rewards
data_flows.description: The mobile app calls the rewards API using an access token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back
data_flows.data_description: rewards requests and member points data

data_flows.name: request authorization
data_flows.description: A partner app initiates authorization for a member and requests scopes.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page

data_flows.name: return authorization code
data_flows.description: The authorization server returns an authorization code to the partner app's redirect URI.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.

data_flows.name: request tokens
data_flows.description: A partner app sends token requests containing its client secret in the request body.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.
data_flows.data_description: client secret, authorization code, and tokens

data_flows.name: show points
data_flows.description: A partner app shows a member's points through the partner API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points

data_flows.name: store identity data
data_flows.description: The authorization server stores member identity and authorization data in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database
data_flows.data_description: accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents

data_flows.name: update ledger
data_flows.description: The rewards API reads and writes balances and points transactions in the points ledger.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

data_flows.name: write requests
data_flows.description: The rewards API writes received requests and headers to the API log store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: close account
data_flows.description: The support console marks a member's account closed in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.
data_flows.notes: The member's refresh tokens remain in the same database.

trust_boundaries.name: our cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud account where the platform components and stores run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account

trust_boundaries.name: member phone
trust_boundaries.description: The members' phones, which are outside the system's cloud account and hold the mobile app's refresh tokens.

trust_boundaries.name: partner server
trust_boundaries.description: Servers operated by other companies that run the partner apps.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: other companies run on their own servers

assumptions.assumption: The points ledger's contents are confidential because they include member balances and points transactions.
assumptions.basis: The store holds every member's balance and every points transaction.

assumptions.assumption: The identity database's contents are confidential because they include personal information, password hashes, tokens, and consents.
assumptions.basis: The store holds member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.

assumptions.assumption: The API log store's contents are confidential because request headers may contain credentials and the logs contain requests to a rewards API.
assumptions.basis: The store contains every request received by the rewards API, including headers.

assumptions.assumption: The rewards API is internet-facing because it is served from a public hostname.
assumptions.basis: The support console and rewards API are served on the same public hostname.

assumptions.assumption: The support console is internet-facing because it is served from a public hostname.
assumptions.basis: The support console and rewards API are served on the same public hostname.
